mapper.select: select coalesce( sum( case when statistics_time >= current_date and is_deleted = 0 then processing_count else 0 end ), 0 ) as today_processed_count, coalesce(sum(duplicate_count), 0) as deduplicated_count from data_processing_statistics where task_id = #{taskId}

select count(1) from dm_alarm_event where alarm_status = 0 and is_deleted = 0
and task_id = #{taskId}
